seo.title: About
seo.description: Craftiniya is a small handmade studio making home decor, candles, crochet and personalized gifts in small batches.

welcome.title: Welcome to Craftiniya
welcome.body: Explore our collections of home decor, candles, crochet, festive essentials and personalized gifts. Find something that feels like you — or like the person you are gifting.

image.alt: Finishing a handmade piece in the studio

services.title: We can help style your home & life

items.title: Handmade Home Decor
items.body: Wall art, nameplates, clocks and tabletop pieces for spaces that feel lived in.

items.title: Candles & Fragrance
items.body: Hand-poured soy candles, sculpted pieces and wax melts for a softly scented home.

items.title: Thoughtful Gifting
items.body: Hampers and ready-to-give gifts for every occasion, wrapped with care.

items.title: Personalized Keepsakes
items.body: Names, dates and words made into pieces that belong to one person alone.

stalls.title: Our Stalls & Exhibitions
stalls.body: Glimpses from artisan fairs, flea markets, and live pop-up stalls where we bring CraftiNiya directly to you.

items.title: Botanical Resin & Decor Stall
items.caption: Live display of preserved floral resin clocks, coasters and tabletop decor.

items.title: Aesthetic Soy Candle Studio
items.caption: Hand-poured dessert and botanical soy candles collection.

items.title: Festive Gifting Pop-up
items.caption: Make Your Gift Box counter and personalized hampers.

items.title: Artisan Collective Showcase
items.caption: Showcasing women artisan crochet bags and traditional wooden resin work.

collaborations.title: Collaborations, Community & Impact
collaborations.subtitle: Partnering with conscious brands, grassroots artisan NGOs, design creators, and affiliate curators.

items.title: Brand Collaborations
items.body: Custom corporate hampers, luxury wedding favours, and co-branded handmade pieces for conscious brands and milestone events.

items.title: NGO & Artisan Collective
items.body: Partnered with local grassroots artisan clusters and women self-help craft initiatives, ensuring fair living wages and preserving traditional Indian handcrafts.

items.title: Creator & Influencer Circle
items.body: Leading home decor curators and aesthetic lifestyle influencers styling CraftiNiya botanicals, candles, and resin pieces in everyday living spaces.

items.title: Affiliate & Partner Picks
items.body: Discover specially curated collections hand-selected by design tastemakers and affiliate partners, highlighting standout studio originals.

policies.title: The practical bits
policies.subtitle: Transparent policies and friendly studio support for an effortless shopping experience.

items.title: Shipping & Delivery
items.body: Made to order in our studio. Dispatched in 2–4 days with 4-layer shockproof packaging.

items.title: Returns & Refunds
items.body: Unused non-custom pieces can come back in 7 days. Transit damage is promptly replaced or refunded.

items.title: Studio Care Guide
items.body: Keep resin away from harsh sun, trim candle wicks to 5mm, spot-clean crochet gently.

items.title: Help & Quick Contact
items.body: Questions on a custom brief, order tracking, or corporate order? We reply within 24 hours.
